parameters.command:
python3 -c "
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
tree = ET.parse('/work/output/artifacts/skill-bpmn-safety-sanitize/CustomerExport.bpmn')
print('XML well-formed: OK')
root = tree.getroot()
xml_str = ET.tostring(root, encoding='unicode')
# Check no private data remains
import sys
bad = ['acme-corp', 'folder-key-11111111', 'connection-id-99999999', 'Jane Doe', 'John Smith', 'Contoso', 'Fabrikam']
found = [b for b in bad if b in xml_str]
if found:
    print('FAIL - private data still present:', found); sys.exit(1)
# Check placeholders present
good = ['<TENANT_URL>', '<FOLDER_KEY>', '<CONNECTION_NAME>', 'Approver A', 'Approver B']
missing = [g for g in good if g not in xml_str]
if missing:
    print('FAIL - placeholders missing:', missing); sys.exit(1)
print('All private data replaced: OK')
print('All placeholders present: OK')
"
